title: Overlap CPU consumers wait on copy completion while stream ordering has a narrower role
mechanism: The overlap confidence-copy path schedules a device-to-host copy after its producer dependency and records a completion event; the CPU consumer queries completion before using that copied confidence. These excerpts contain no wait for a previous occupant when a ring slot is selected, so a complete slot-reuse lifetime proof cannot be inferred. resolve_seq_lens_cpu can skip the initial event wait when stream_ordered is set, but a private device-to-host copy still has its own completion wait before CPU use. When CPU sequence lengths are unnecessary it returns None; otherwise the selected path synchronizes the transfer before returning host values.
corrections: A producer stream dependency and a CPU-visible copy completion are separate boundaries.
Do not infer safe ring-buffer slot reuse from the confidence consumer check alone.
No real asynchronous device race or throughput effect was measured.
source_scope: Manually read the listed exact Git ranges for the final corrected mechanism. All other model claims remain research notes; no runtime experiment.
